---
title: "Collapse Output"
subtitle: "Quarto Extension"
author:
  - name: "Mickaël CANOUIL, _Ph.D._"
    orcid: "0000-0002-3396-4549"
    url: "https://mickael.canouil.fr"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
engine: jupyter
jupyter: python3
filters:
  - collapse-output
extensions:
  collapse-output:
    method: lua
    default-open: false
    summary-template: "{type} ({lines} lines)"
    summaries:
      stdout: "Console output"
---

Mark a cell with `output-fold` and its output is wrapped in a `<details>` element, leaving the source alone.

```{python}
#| output-fold: true

for i in range(12):
    print(f"line {i}")
```

`output-summary` replaces the summary text for one cell, and `output-open` starts it open.

```{python}
#| output-fold: true
#| output-summary: "The first three squares"
#| output-open: true

print([i * i for i in range(1, 4)])
```

Set `collapse-all-outputs: true` to fold every cell instead, then opt individual ones out with `output-fold: false`.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-collapse-output/>.
